page.notes: The left margin mark beside "que affici" is smudged and only partly legible; the note above is a best reading. The running head bar is decorative and its wording cannot be read. The word "ę-quum" at the line end is doubtful: the abbreviation before "quum" may be æ, so check against the scan. "dië" and "indefinitę" are copied as printed. The last line "ue-" is a line-end fragment and is kept as printed, with u changed to v.
